location_fine: apartment living room and front hallway
key_props: laid table with fruit, champagne and sweets
visual_synopsis: The video opens with a cheerful family party in an apartment living room - eight people around a laid table with fruit and champagne, two men in front of a big TV - then cuts to the same living room turned into a house of mourning, with women in black head shawls weeping on the sofa and a mustachioed man sitting silently in the armchair. The running gag is at the front door, where a young man in a dark jacket keeps turning up with a different woman on his arm each time, giving a small wave, while the mustachioed man shuttles in and out putting on and taking off his jacket.
